Female C57BL/6 mice after myocardial infarction, AAV-Mock vs AAV-shCiita. Four mice per group; nuclei of two mice were pooled per sample (2 samples per condition). Raw data are available from ArrayExpress.

The input is the processed Seurat object (`snRNA_heart_mouse_shCiitaVsMock.rds`) generated in Python from the Cell Ranger output. Preprocessing covered filtering, doublet removal (scDblFinder), normalisation, Harmony integration, clustering and cell-type annotation. The object contains raw counts, a UMAP and the metadata columns `annotation`, `condition` and `batch`.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(Seurat)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(decontX)
library(harmony)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplotify)
library(ggrepel)
library(DESeq2)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 16 * 1024^3)
set.seed(42)

input_rds <- "data/snRNA_heart_mouse_shCiitaVsMock.rds"
obj_dir   <- "objects"
out_dir   <- "figures"
tab_dir   <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
dir.create(obj_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Helper functions

```{r}
#| label: helpers
heatmap_colors   <- colorRampPalette(c("#083269", "#8DC1DA", "#D4E6EE", "white",
                                       "#F9DCCC", "#EC9977", "#BF0027"))(100)
condition_colors <- c(Mock = "#D4D4D4", shCiita = "#F93F40")

theme_box <- theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"))

save_plot <- function(p, file, width, height) {
  ggsave(file, p, path = out_dir, width = width, height = height)
  p
}

recluster <- function(obj, dims = 1:20, resolution = 0.5, nfeatures = 2000) {
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = nfeatures, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = max(dims) + 10, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunHarmony(obj, group.by.vars = "batch", verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims, reduction.name = "umap_sub", verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = dims, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = resolution, verbose = FALSE)
  obj$subcluster <- obj$seurat_clusters
  obj
}

add_score <- function(obj, genes, name, ...) {
  genes <- genes[genes %in% rownames(obj)]
  obj <- AddModuleScore(obj, features = list(genes), name = name, ...)
  obj@meta.data[[name]] <- obj@meta.data[[paste0(name, "1")]]
  obj@meta.data[[paste0(name, "1")]] <- NULL
  obj
}

check_cluster_sizes <- function(obj, expected, what) {
  observed <- as.numeric(table(obj$subcluster))
  if (length(observed) != length(expected) || any(observed != expected)) {
    warning(what, ": cluster sizes differ from the published analysis. ",
            "Check the cluster names against the marker genes before continuing.")
  }
}

pheatmap_left <- function(..., legend_title = NULL) {
  grDevices::pdf(NULL)
  dev <- grDevices::dev.cur()
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(dev), add = TRUE)
  g <- pheatmap(..., silent = TRUE)$gtable

  rn <- which(g$layout$name == "row_names")
  if (length(rn) == 1) {
    old_col <- g$layout$l[rn]
    g <- gtable::gtable_add_cols(g, g$widths[old_col], pos = 0)
    g$widths[old_col + 1] <- unit(0, "pt")
    for (nm in c("row_names", "col_annotation_names")) {
      i <- which(g$layout$name == nm)
      if (length(i) == 1) {
        g$layout$l[i] <- 1
        g$layout$r[i] <- 1
        g$grobs[[i]]$hjust <- 1
        g$grobs[[i]]$x <- unit(1, "npc") - unit(3, "bigpts")
      }
    }
  }

  li <- which(g$layout$name == "legend")
  if (length(li) == 1) {
    title_h <- if (is.null(legend_title)) unit(0, "bigpts") else unit(24, "bigpts")
    leg_h <- grid::unit.pmin(unit(1, "npc") - title_h, unit(150, "bigpts"))
    kids <- grid::gList(grid::gTree(children = grid::gList(g$grobs[[li]]),
                                    vp = grid::viewport(y = 0, height = leg_h, just = "bottom")))
    if (!is.null(legend_title)) {
      tg <- grid::textGrob(legend_title, x = 0, y = leg_h + unit(8, "bigpts"),
                           just = c("left", "bottom"), gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14))
      kids <- grid::gList(kids, tg)
      lc <- g$layout$l[li]
      mc <- g$layout$l[g$layout$name == "matrix"]
      new_w <- max(g$widths[lc], unit(grid::convertWidth(grid::grobWidth(tg), "bigpts", TRUE) + 4, "bigpts"))
      g$widths[mc] <- g$widths[mc] - (new_w - g$widths[lc])
      g$widths[lc] <- new_w
    }
    g$grobs[[li]] <- grid::gTree(children = kids)
    g$layout$b[li] <- g$layout$b[g$layout$name == "matrix"]
  }
  as.ggplot(g)
}

plot_marker_heatmap <- function(obj, genes, group.by, group_order, file, width, height, clip = 2) {
  genes <- unique(genes[genes %in% rownames(obj)])
  grp <- droplevels(factor(obj@meta.data[[group.by]]))
  expr <- expm1(GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  design <- Matrix::t(Matrix::fac2sparse(grp))
  avg <- as.matrix(expr %*% design) %*% diag(1 / Matrix::colSums(design), ncol(design))
  colnames(avg) <- levels(grp)
  z <- t(scale(t(avg)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z <- z[, intersect(group_order, colnames(z)), drop = FALSE]
  z <- pmin(pmax(z, -clip), clip)
  p <- pheatmap_left(z, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     color = heatmap_colors, breaks = seq(-clip, clip, length.out = 101),
                     border_color = "grey80", fontsize_row = 10, fontsize_col = 10, angle_col = 90,
                     legend_title = "Z-score")
  save_plot(p, file, width, height)
}

per_sample <- function(obj, value, group.by) {
  obj@meta.data %>%
    mutate(.value = value) %>%
    group_by(group = .data[[group.by]], batch, condition, .drop = TRUE) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.value),
              logmean = log1p(mean(expm1(.value))),
              n_nuclei = n(), .groups = "drop")
}

plot_group_box <- function(df, y, ylab, title = NULL, from_zero = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(group, .data[[y]], fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, colour = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(aes(group = condition),
               position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0,
                                               dodge.width = 0.8, seed = 1),
               size = 2.5, shape = 15, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab, fill = NULL) +
    theme_box +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  if (from_zero) p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))
  p
}

plot_single_box <- function(df, ylab, title, from_zero = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(condition, value, fill = condition)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(shape = 15, size = 2.5, colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_box
  if (from_zero) {
    p + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)))
  } else {
    p + geom_blank(data = mutate(df, value = 0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.08)))
  }
}

pseudobulk <- function(counts, samples) {
  samples <- factor(samples)
  design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + samples)
  colnames(design) <- levels(samples)
  as.matrix(counts %*% design)
}

run_pseudobulk_de <- function(obj, group.by, min_nuclei = 10) {
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = raw_assay, layer = "counts")
  md <- obj@meta.data
  results_list <- list()
  for (g in levels(droplevels(factor(md[[group.by]])))) {
    cells <- rownames(md)[md[[group.by]] == g]
    n_per_sample <- table(md[cells, "batch"])
    cells <- cells[md[cells, "batch"] %in% names(n_per_sample)[n_per_sample >= min_nuclei]]
    col_data <- md[cells, ] %>% distinct(batch, condition) %>%
      mutate(batch = as.character(batch)) %>% arrange(batch)
    if (nlevels(droplevels(factor(col_data$condition))) < 2 ||
        any(table(droplevels(factor(col_data$condition))) < 2)) next

    pb <- pseudobulk(counts[, cells], as.character(md[cells, "batch"]))[, col_data$batch]
    pb <- pb[rowSums(pb >= 10) >= 2, , drop = FALSE]
    dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(pb), colData = data.frame(col_data, row.names = col_data$batch),
                                  design = ~ condition)
    dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
    results_list[[g]] <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "shCiita", "Mock")) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
      mutate(celltype = g, n_nuclei = length(cells)) %>%
      arrange(pvalue)
  }
  bind_rows(results_list)
}

absent_in_one_condition <- function(obj, group.by, group) {
  cells <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[group.by]] == group]
  pb <- pseudobulk(GetAssayData(obj, assay = raw_assay, layer = "counts")[, cells],
                   as.character(obj$batch[match(cells, colnames(obj))]))
  cond <- as.character(sample_info$condition[match(colnames(pb), sample_info$batch)])
  zero_mock <- rowSums(pb[, cond == "Mock", drop = FALSE]) == 0
  zero_sh   <- rowSums(pb[, cond == "shCiita", drop = FALSE]) == 0
  rownames(pb)[zero_mock | zero_sh]
}

plot_volcano <- function(res, label_genes, title, file, exclude = character(0)) {
  df <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue), !gene %in% exclude) %>%
    mutate(dir = case_when(pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "up in shCiita",
                           pvalue < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "down in shCiita",
                           TRUE ~ "n.s."),
           sig_adj = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pvalue))) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = dir), size = 1) +
    geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(df, sig_adj), shape = 21, size = 2.2, colour = "black", stroke = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), colour = "grey50", linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey80") +
    geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(df, gene %in% label_genes), aes(label = gene),
                    size = 3.2, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = 50, min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("up in shCiita" = "#BF0027", "down in shCiita" = "#083269",
                                   "n.s." = "grey80")) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 fold change (shCiita vs Mock)", y = "-log10 P", colour = NULL) +
    theme_box
  save_plot(p, file, 6, 5)
}

plot_sample_heatmap <- function(obj, group.by, group, genes, title, file, gaps_row = NULL) {
  cells <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[group.by]] == group]
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = raw_assay, layer = "counts")[, cells]
  pb <- pseudobulk(counts, as.character(obj$batch[match(cells, colnames(obj))]))
  pb <- pb[, intersect(sample_order, colnames(pb)), drop = FALSE]
  sf <- DESeq2::estimateSizeFactorsForMatrix(pb[rowSums(pb >= 10) >= 2, , drop = FALSE])
  norm <- log2(sweep(pb, 2, sf, "/") + 1)
  genes <- genes[genes %in% rownames(norm)]
  z <- t(scale(t(norm[genes, , drop = FALSE])))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  anno <- data.frame(condition = as.character(sample_info$condition[match(colnames(z), sample_info$batch)]),
                     row.names = colnames(z))
  p <- pheatmap_left(z, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                     color = heatmap_colors, breaks = seq(-1.6, 1.6, length.out = 101),
                     border_color = "grey80", fontsize_row = 10, fontsize_col = 10, angle_col = 90,
                     annotation_col = anno, annotation_colors = list(condition = condition_colors),
                     annotation_legend = FALSE, gaps_col = 2, gaps_row = gaps_row,
                     legend_title = "Z-score", main = title)
  save_plot(p, file, 3.6, 1.6 + 0.3 * length(genes))
}

top_genes <- function(res, exclude, n = 10) {
  top <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pvalue), pvalue < 0.05, !gene %in% exclude, !grepl("^Hb[ab]-", gene)) %>%
    arrange(pvalue)
  list(up = head(top$gene[top$log2FoldChange > 0], n),
       down = head(top$gene[top$log2FoldChange < 0], n))
}
```

## Load the processed object

```{r}
#| label: load
data <- readRDS(input_rds)
if (inherits(data, "SingleCellExperiment")) {
  data <- as.Seurat(data, counts = "counts", data = "logcounts")
}
stopifnot(all(c("annotation", "condition", "batch") %in% colnames(data@meta.data)))

raw_assay <- DefaultAssay(data)
umap_red  <- grep("umap", Reductions(data), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]

cell_order <- c("CM", "ArtEC", "VeinEC", "EndoEC", "LymphEC", "CapEC",
                "T_cells", "B_cells", "MP", "MP_recruited", "Mast",
                "Pericytes", "SMC", "Fibroblasts", "Fibro_activ", "Adip", "Epi_cells")
data$annotation <- factor(as.character(data$annotation),
                          levels = c(cell_order, setdiff(unique(as.character(data$annotation)), cell_order)))
data$condition <- factor(as.character(data$condition), levels = c("Mock", "shCiita"))
data$batch     <- factor(as.character(data$batch))

sample_info  <- data@meta.data %>% distinct(batch, condition) %>% arrange(condition, batch)
sample_order <- as.character(sample_info$batch)
```

## Ambient RNA removal (decontX)

```{r}
#| label: decontx
decontx_rds <- file.path(obj_dir, "snRNA_heart_decontX_filtered.rds")
contamination_cutoff <- 0.2

if (file.exists(decontx_rds)) {
  data <- readRDS(decontx_rds)
} else {
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays  = list(counts = GetAssayData(data, assay = raw_assay, layer = "counts")),
    colData = data@meta.data[, c("batch", "annotation")]
  )
  sce <- decontX(sce, z = as.character(sce$annotation), batch = as.character(sce$batch))

  data$decontX_contamination <- sce$decontX_contamination
  data[["decontX"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = decontXcounts(sce))
  DefaultAssay(data) <- "decontX"
  data <- NormalizeData(data, verbose = FALSE)
  rm(sce); gc()

  data$decontX_removed <- data$decontX_contamination >= contamination_cutoff
  qc <- data@meta.data %>%
    group_by(batch, condition) %>%
    summarise(nuclei_before = n(),
              removed = sum(decontX_removed),
              nuclei_after = sum(!decontX_removed),
              median_contamination = median(decontX_contamination), .groups = "drop")
  write.csv(qc, file.path(tab_dir, "decontX_QC_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  data <- subset(data, cells = colnames(data)[!data$decontX_removed])
  saveRDS(data, decontx_rds)
}
DefaultAssay(data) <- "decontX"
data$annotation <- droplevels(data$annotation)
```

## Endothelial cells: re-clustering and venous ECs

```{r}
#| label: ec-subclustering
ec_sub <- subset(data, subset = annotation %in% c("ArtEC", "EndoEC", "LymphEC", "CapEC"))
ec_sub$annotation_original <- as.character(ec_sub$annotation)
ec_sub <- recluster(ec_sub, dims = 1:20, resolution = 0.8)

ec_programmes <- list(
  ArtEC   = c("Sema3g", "Gja5", "Gja4", "Efnb2", "Hey1", "Bmx"),
  VeinEC  = c("Nr2f2", "Vwf", "Vcam1", "Ackr1", "Selp", "Lrg1"),
  EndoEC  = c("Npr3", "Nrg1", "Cdh11", "Nfatc1", "Hapln1"),
  LymphEC = c("Prox1", "Mmrn1", "Flt4", "Reln"),
  CapEC   = c("Rgcc", "Car4", "Aplnr", "Cd36")
)
for (s in names(ec_programmes)) ec_sub <- add_score(ec_sub, ec_programmes[[s]], paste0("prog_", s))
prog_cols <- paste0("prog_", names(ec_programmes))

ec_calls <- ec_sub@meta.data %>%
  group_by(subcluster) %>%
  summarise(n_nuclei = n(),
            original_label = names(which.max(table(annotation_original))),
            across(all_of(prog_cols), mean), .groups = "drop")
z <- scale(as.matrix(ec_calls[, prog_cols]))
colnames(z) <- names(ec_programmes)
z_best     <- apply(z, 1, max)
best       <- colnames(z)[apply(z, 1, which.max)]
z_original <- z[cbind(seq_len(nrow(z)), match(ec_calls$original_label, colnames(z)))]
ec_calls$label <- ifelse(best == "VeinEC" & z_best - z_original > 0.5 & z_best > 0.5,
                         "VeinEC", ec_calls$original_label)
write.csv(ec_calls, file.path(tab_dir, "EC_subcluster_calls.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

ec_types <- c("ArtEC", "VeinEC", "EndoEC", "LymphEC", "CapEC")
ec_types <- ec_types[ec_types %in% ec_calls$label]
ec_sub$ec_type <- factor(ec_calls$label[match(ec_sub$subcluster, ec_calls$subcluster)], levels = ec_types)

new_annotation <- as.character(data$annotation)
new_annotation[match(colnames(ec_sub), colnames(data))] <- as.character(ec_sub$ec_type)
data$annotation <- droplevels(factor(new_annotation,
                                     levels = c(cell_order, setdiff(unique(new_annotation), cell_order))))
```

## Immune cells: re-clustering

```{r}
#| label: immune-subclustering
immune <- subset(data, subset = annotation %in% c("T_cells", "B_cells", "MP", "MP_recruited", "Mast"))
immune <- recluster(immune, dims = 1:20, resolution = 0.8)
check_cluster_sizes(immune, c(2802, 2182, 2092, 1676, 904, 822, 722, 511, 492, 367, 351, 261,
                              259, 231, 169, 136, 104, 85, 69), "Immune cells")

immune_labels <- c(
  "0"  = "MP_resident",
  "2"  = "MP_resident",
  "3"  = "MP_resident",
  "14" = "MP_resident",
  "1"  = "MP_MHCIIhi",
  "6"  = "MP_Lgals3",
  "10" = "MP_Arg1_Spp1",
  "11" = "MP_IFN",
  "8"  = "MoMP_Ccr2",
  "7"  = "Mono_Ly6Clo",
  "15" = "Neutrophils",
  "13" = "cDC1",
  "9"  = "Cycling",
  "4"  = "T_cells",
  "17" = "Treg",
  "18" = "gdT17",
  "12" = "NK_cells",
  "16" = "ILC2",
  "5"  = "B_cells"
)
immune$immune_annot <- unname(immune_labels[as.character(immune$subcluster)])

major_types <- c(MP_resident = "MP", MP_MHCIIhi = "MP", MP_Lgals3 = "MP", MP_IFN = "MP",
                 MP_Arg1_Spp1 = "MP_recruited", Cycling = "MP_recruited",
                 MoMP_Ccr2 = "MP_recruited", Mono_Ly6Clo = "MP_recruited",
                 Treg = "T_cells", gdT17 = "T_cells")
major <- immune$immune_annot
major[major %in% names(major_types)] <- major_types[major[major %in% names(major_types)]]
immune$immune_major <- factor(major, levels = c("MP", "MP_recruited", "Neutrophils", "cDC1", "T_cells",
                                                "NK_cells", "ILC2", "B_cells"))
```

## T cells: re-clustering

```{r}
#| label: tcell-subclustering
lymph <- subset(data, subset = annotation == "T_cells")
lymph <- recluster(lymph, dims = 1:15, resolution = 0.8)
check_cluster_sizes(lymph, c(338, 243, 157, 116, 108, 94, 93, 78, 75, 70, 34, 18, 13), "Lymphocytes")

t_clusters <- c("0", "1", "3", "6", "7", "8", "9", "10")
tcells <- subset(lymph, subset = subcluster %in% t_clusters)
tcells <- recluster(tcells, dims = 1:15, resolution = 0.8)

t_signatures <- list(
  Naive_CD4   = c("Cd4", "Klf2", "Il7r", "Ccr7", "Lef1", "Tcf7"),
  Naive_CD8   = c("Cd8a", "Cd8b1", "Dapl1", "Klf2", "Ccr7", "Lef1"),
  Resting_CD8 = c("Cd8a", "Cd8b1", "Ly6c1", "Il7r"),
  Memory_CD8  = c("Cd8a", "Cd8b1", "Ly6c2", "Cxcr3", "Il2rb", "Ccl5", "Gzmk"),
  Effector_T  = c("Id2", "Ifng", "Klrk1", "Nkg7", "S100a6", "Cxcr6", "Il2rb"),
  Treg        = c("Ctla4", "Il2ra", "Tnfrsf4", "Tnfrsf18", "Foxp3", "Ikzf2", "Itgae"),
  gdT         = c("Trdc", "Tcrg-C1", "Il23r", "Rorc", "Zbtb16"),
  Cycling     = c("Tk1", "Ube2c", "Mki67", "Top2a")
)
for (s in names(t_signatures)) tcells <- add_score(tcells, t_signatures[[s]], paste0("tsig_", s))
tsig_cols <- paste0("tsig_", names(t_signatures))

t_calls <- tcells@meta.data %>%
  group_by(subcluster) %>%
  summarise(n_nuclei = n(), across(all_of(tsig_cols), mean), .groups = "drop")
tz <- scale(as.matrix(t_calls[, tsig_cols]))
tz[is.na(tz)] <- 0
colnames(tz) <- names(t_signatures)
t_calls$label <- colnames(tz)[apply(tz, 1, which.max)]
t_calls$label[t_calls$subcluster == "7"] <- "Proliferating_NKT"
write.csv(t_calls, file.path(tab_dir, "Tcell_subcluster_calls.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

t_order <- c("Naive_CD4", "Naive_CD8", "Resting_CD8", "Memory_CD8", "Effector_T",
             "Proliferating_NKT", "Cycling", "Treg", "gdT")
t_order <- c(intersect(t_order, t_calls$label), setdiff(unique(t_calls$label), t_order))
tcells$t_subtype <- factor(t_calls$label[match(tcells$subcluster, t_calls$subcluster)], levels = t_order)
t_order <- levels(droplevels(tcells$t_subtype))
```

## Cell labels used in the paper

Re-clustering can differ slightly between package versions and runs. To reproduce the published figure exactly, the EC, immune and T cell labels and the subcluster UMAPs of the published analysis are loaded from `metadata/published_cell_labels.csv.gz`.

```{r}
#| label: published-labels
published <- read.csv(gzfile("metadata/published_cell_labels.csv.gz"))
rownames(published) <- published$cell

ec_types <- intersect(c("ArtEC", "VeinEC", "EndoEC", "LymphEC", "CapEC"), published$ec_type)
ec_sub <- subset(data, cells = published$cell[!is.na(published$ec_type)])
ec_sub$ec_type <- factor(published[colnames(ec_sub), "ec_type"], levels = ec_types)
ec_umap <- as.matrix(published[colnames(ec_sub), c("ec_umap_1", "ec_umap_2")])
colnames(ec_umap) <- c("umapsub_1", "umapsub_2")
ec_sub[["umap_sub"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(ec_umap, key = "umapsub_", assay = "decontX")

new_annotation <- as.character(data$annotation)
new_annotation[match(colnames(ec_sub), colnames(data))] <- as.character(ec_sub$ec_type)
data$annotation <- droplevels(factor(new_annotation,
                                     levels = c(cell_order, setdiff(unique(new_annotation), cell_order))))

immune$immune_annot <- published[colnames(immune), "immune_annot"]
major <- immune$immune_annot
major[major %in% names(major_types)] <- major_types[major[major %in% names(major_types)]]
immune$immune_major <- factor(major, levels = c("MP", "MP_recruited", "Neutrophils", "cDC1", "T_cells",
                                                "NK_cells", "ILC2", "B_cells"))

t_order <- c("Naive_CD4", "Naive_CD8", "Resting_CD8", "Memory_CD8", "Effector_T",
             "Proliferating_NKT", "Cycling", "Treg", "gdT")
tcells <- subset(data, cells = published$cell[!is.na(published$t_subtype)])
tcells$t_subtype <- droplevels(factor(published[colnames(tcells), "t_subtype"], levels = t_order))
t_order <- levels(tcells$t_subtype)
t_umap <- as.matrix(published[colnames(tcells), c("t_umap_1", "t_umap_2")])
colnames(t_umap) <- c("umapsub_1", "umapsub_2")
tcells[["umap_sub"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(t_umap, key = "umapsub_", assay = "decontX")

stopifnot(!anyNA(ec_sub$ec_type), !anyNA(immune$immune_annot), !anyNA(tcells$t_subtype))
```

## Ciita and MHC-II in ECs and macrophages

```{r}
#| label: fig-ciita-mhcii
#| fig-width: 2.4
#| fig-height: 3.4
compare_groups <- c("ECs", "MP", "MP_recruited")
celltype <- unname(as.character(data$celltype))
data$compare_group <- case_when(celltype %in% ec_types ~ "ECs",
                                celltype %in% c("MP", "MP_recruited") ~ celltype,
                                TRUE ~ NA_character_)

ciita_compare <- per_sample(data, FetchData(data, vars = "Ciita", layer = "data")[, 1], "compare_group") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  transmute(group, batch, condition, value = logmean, measure = "Ciita")

ec_sub <- add_score(ec_sub, mhc_genes, "MHCII_score", seed = 42)
mhc_within <- setNames(ec_sub$MHCII_score, colnames(ec_sub))
for (g in c("MP", "MP_recruited")) {
  o <- subset(data, cells = colnames(data)[which(data$compare_group == g)])
  o <- add_score(o, mhc_genes, "MHCII_score", seed = 42)
  mhc_within <- c(mhc_within, setNames(o$MHCII_score, colnames(o)))
}
mhc_compare <- data@meta.data %>%
  mutate(score = unname(mhc_within[colnames(data)])) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(compare_group)) %>%
  group_by(group = compare_group, batch, condition) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(measure = "MHCII_score")

compare_df <- bind_rows(ciita_compare, mhc_compare)
write.csv(compare_df, file.path(tab_dir, "Ciita_MHCII_ECs_vs_MP_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

for (g in compare_groups) {
  p <- plot_single_box(dplyr::filter(compare_df, measure == "Ciita", group == g),
                       "Ciita expression (Log(nUMI))", g)
  print(save_plot(p, paste0("Boxplot_Ciita_", g, ".pdf"), 2.4, 3.4))

  p <- plot_single_box(dplyr::filter(compare_df, measure == "MHCII_score", group == g),
                       "MHC-II score", g, from_zero = FALSE) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2)
  print(save_plot(p, paste0("Boxplot_MHCII_score_", g, ".pdf"), 2.4, 3.4))
}
```

## Differential expression in T cells and recruited macrophages

```{r}
#| label: fig-deg
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
de_t <- run_pseudobulk_de(subset(immune, subset = immune_major == "T_cells"), "immune_major")
write.csv(de_t, file.path(tab_dir, "PseudobulkDE_Tcells_shCiita_vs_Mock.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mp <- subset(immune, subset = immune_major %in% c("MP", "MP_recruited"))
mp$immune_major <- droplevels(mp$immune_major)
de_mp <- run_pseudobulk_de(mp, "immune_major")
write.csv(de_mp, file.path(tab_dir, "PseudobulkDE_MP_MPrecruited_shCiita_vs_Mock.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

deg_sets <- list(
  Tcells = list(obj = immune, group.by = "immune_major", group = "T_cells", res = de_t,
                title = "T cells: shCiita vs Mock",
                labels = c("Cd44", "Mir155hg", "Itgb8", "Capg", "Ifngas1", "Myo1e")),
  MP_recruited = list(obj = mp, group.by = "immune_major", group = "MP_recruited",
                      res = dplyr::filter(de_mp, celltype == "MP_recruited"),
                      title = "MP_recruited: shCiita vs Mock",
                      labels = c("Spp1", "Mmp19", "Adamts6", "Mmp12", "Arg1", "Retnla", "Chil3", "Lpl",
                                 "Cd36", "Fn1", "Ace", "Treml4", "Cd300e", "Nr4a1"))
)

top_tables <- list()
for (nm in names(deg_sets)) {
  s <- deg_sets[[nm]]
  excl <- absent_in_one_condition(s$obj, s$group.by, s$group)
  print(plot_volcano(s$res, s$labels, s$title, paste0("Volcano_", nm, ".pdf"), exclude = excl))

  top <- top_genes(s$res, excl, n = 10)
  gap <- if (length(top$up) > 0 && length(top$down) > 0) length(top$up) else NULL
  plot_sample_heatmap(s$obj, s$group.by, s$group, c(top$up, top$down), nm,
                      paste0("Heatmap_", nm, "_top10_up_down.pdf"), gaps_row = gap)
  top_tables[[nm]] <- dplyr::filter(s$res, gene %in% c(top$up, top$down))
}
write.csv(bind_rows(top_tables, .id = "group") %>%
            dplyr::select(group, gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj),
          file.path(tab_dir, "Top10_up_down_genes_heatmaps.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Il1b in resident macrophages

```{r}
#| label: fig-il1b
#| fig-width: 2.4
#| fig-height: 3.4
mp_resident <- subset(mp, subset = immune_major == "MP")
il1b <- per_sample(mp_resident, FetchData(mp_resident, vars = "Il1b", layer = "data")[, 1], "immune_major")
write.csv(il1b, file.path(tab_dir, "Il1b_MP_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

format_p <- function(x) {
  e <- floor(log10(x))
  sprintf("p = %.2fe%s%03d", x / 10^e, ifelse(e < 0, "-", "+"), abs(e))
}
il1b_p <- de_mp %>% dplyr::filter(celltype == "MP", gene == "Il1b") %>% pull(pvalue)
y_top <- max(il1b$logmean) * 1.12

p <- ggplot(il1b, aes(condition, logmean, fill = condition)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, colour = "black", outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 2.5, colour = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = c(1, 1, 2), xend = c(2, 1, 2),
           y = y_top, yend = c(y_top, y_top * 0.95, y_top * 0.95), linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.04, label = format_p(il1b_p), size = 3.5, vjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_top * 1.15), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "MP", x = NULL, y = "Il1b expression (Log(nUMI))") +
  theme_box
save_plot(p, "Boxplot_Il1b_MP.pdf", 2.4, 3.4)
```
